title: Independent beauty professional pricing confidence
core_problem: Trained in technique, not business; pricing is guesswork and they fear raising prices.
desired_outcome: Price services profitably and confidently without losing clients.
related_problems: I don't know what to charge
don't know my real profit margin

problems.statement: Beauty pros pay for pricing/business assets.
symptoms: GraphicLabPro (beauty price-list templates): 7.4k sales, 4.8★ (666 reviews), Star Seller.
Nail-specific pricing calculators exist ($3.50-11) but Etsy 'Bestseller' badges cluster on GENERIC small-business calculators.

problems.statement: Growing base of solo beauty operators.
symptoms: At-home/independent nail techs are a documented growth category.
r/Nailtechs is small (~29k) and pricing threads get modest engagement; beauty biz talk skews to Facebook/IG.

solution_gaps: pricing confidence/scripts, not just a calculator
creator_ecosystem: inferred large (beauty-business creators on IG/TikTok) but not measured this session
digital_product_fit: Good: calculator + service-menu + no-show/deposit scripts bundle (~$15-29).

demand_evidence.rationale: Real spend + growth, but Reddit signal thin; lives on FB/IG.

existing_wtp.rationale: Spend concentrates in design/generic tools, not niche strategy.

creator_density.rationale: Beauty-biz creators are abundant, but not measured.
